articles.title: How Jude Bellingham Became Tuchel's Tactical Chameleon
articles.summary: In England's 2-0 win over Panama, Jude Bellingham played a hybrid box-to-box role, filling the gap left by injured Declan Rice. Coach Thomas Tuchel praised his adaptability, calling him crucial to the team's evolving system.

articles.title: Labour's 'Coronation': Party Unites Behind Andy Burnham After Starmer's Resignation
articles.summary: Senior Labour figures say the party is coalescing around Andy Burnham as the next leader, avoiding a potentially damaging contest. Deputy leader Lucy Powell and Housing Secretary Steve Reed both endorsed a swift transition, while a challenger awaits Burnham's economic speech on Monday.
